@graph.name: Website Audits for Clinics and Medical Centers
@graph.description: Clinics and medical centers make up more than half of the companies whose websites we reviewed in 2026. We know which pages international patients use to choose a clinic: services, doctors, prices, reviews, and appointment booking. Errors on these pages make patients doubt the clinic's standards before the first consultation.

@graph.name: Website Audits for Clinics and Medical Centers

mainEntity.name: Which pages of a clinic website should be checked first?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pages patients use to choose a clinic and book an appointment: services, doctors, prices, reviews, appointment booking, and contacts. They are a good starting point for a pilot audit of 5 key pages.

mainEntity.name: Do you need access to the website's content management system?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We review the website the way your customers see it. All we need to start is the website address and a business email.
